summary: OceanaGold Corporation, a Canadian-domiciled gold miner listed in the US via Form 6-K (the Canadian equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report), filed its routine Q3 2026 interim reporting package: condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, MD&A, CEO and CFO interim certifications, and a November 4, 2026 news release. No transaction, offer, stakeholder action or board-level structural event is disclosed. Revenue was $654.9M for the quarter with net profit of $203.8M; cash rose to $728.7M. No special-situation angle exists; monitor ordinary operating and commodity exposure.
